label: extension

args.body:
Dear City Hub Tokyo Team,

I am writing to enquire about a group stay at City Hub Tokyo for 10 people during the month of June.

Could you please let me know:
1. What availability you have for a group of 10 guests in June?
2. What room types and configurations would be suitable for a group of this size?
3. Any group booking rates or discounts you may offer?

I would appreciate any additional information about the booking process for groups, as well as your cancellation policy.

Thank you very much for your time. I look forward to hearing from you.

Kind regards,
Emma Johnson
Email: emma.johnson@bluesparrowtech.com
Phone: 327-420-4923
args.subject: Group Booking Enquiry - Availability for 10 People in June
